$comment: P16a per-target limits, checked against official pages 2026-11-03 (D186). Each target lists the fields the platform receives. A field's text is composed from post.json parts ('from', joined by composeField in services/posting/index.mjs: parts separated by a blank line, hashtags joined by spaces) so the check sees exactly what an uploader will send. unit: chars = Unicode code points; utf16 = UTF-16 code units; utf8-bytes = UTF-8 bytes (Malayalam letters are 3 bytes each); youtube-tags = total tag characters plus a comma between tags plus 2 quotes per tag that contains a space. forbid = characters the field must not contain. hashtagMax / mentionMax count #tags / @mentions inside the composed field. Over a limit = flagged and approval refused, never truncated. A field without max is not length-checked.

video.source: agent default 2026-11-08 (conservative: 60 s is the classic Shorts limit; YouTube is reported to accept Shorts up to 3 min since 2024, not checked here). Not a user instruction; the user chose montage length 20-60 s (D298)

youtube-shorts.source: https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs/videos (snippet.title max 100 characters, no < or >; snippet.description max 5000 bytes, no < or >; snippet.tags max 500 characters with commas and added quotes); https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/6390658 (more than 60 hashtags: all hashtags on the video are ignored)

youtube-video.source: https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs/videos (snippet.title max 100 characters, no < or >; snippet.description max 5000 bytes, no < or >; snippet.tags max 500 characters with commas and added quotes); https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/6390658 (more than 60 hashtags: all hashtags on the video are ignored)
youtube-video.note: Same text limits as Shorts; no duration cap, any aspect. Used for finished videos that are not Shorts (D301).

tiktok.source: https://developers.tiktok.com/docs/en/content-posting-api-reference-direct-post (post_info.title is the video caption, max 2200 UTF-16 runes; hashtags and mentions are parsed from it; no hashtag count limit stated)
tiktok.note: The template title is shown in review only; a TikTok video post has no separate title field.

instagram-reels.source: https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform/instagram-graph-api/reference/ig-user/media (caption: maximum 2200 characters, 30 hashtags, 20 @ tags; applies to video, so to Reels)
instagram-reels.note: The page says 'characters' without a unit; UTF-16 code units are used because they are never fewer than code points (stricter). The template title is shown in review only.
